title: Desk task: ticket round trip and a real fleet order
table_note: scenario (a)+(b) ticket round trip through the product's control service (ids, states, receipts, device readback, recorded product limits F3/F4/F6) AND a real warehouse-board-shaped task as a fleet order on the installed plugin (create -> decompose -> claim -> built -> check -> verdict -> bank -> done). Stand-ins named: Get Help/phone UI, scripted board.
operator_action: operator raises a ticket from an employee device, works it on the management screen (claim, reply, receipt), and confirms the employee sees the resolution; the warehouse-board task is worked as a fleet order on the platform
expected: the ticket moves queued -> working -> resolved with a stored receipt, and the employee device reads exactly the host record; the fleet order reaches done with its task done+banked and every op id recorded

B3 order decomposed to one board-shaped task

every fleet op answered ok and is recorded

findings.name: product limit F4
findings.detail: agent ticket-worker credential cannot post a reply — observed HTTP 403 worker_route_denied

findings.name: product limit F3
findings.detail: agent ticket-worker credential cannot finish resolved without a remote binding — observed HTTP 409 remote_binding_required

findings.name: product limit F6
findings.detail: the ticket record carries a free-text worker and replies have no author; Dana and Sam share one operator token — observed worker=sam-akintola reply-authors=0

findings.name: warehouse board app
findings.detail: The warehouse-board app source lives only on the offline work PC (PACKAGE-PENDING). This order is a real fleet order carrying the board-shaped task; the board state it names is the fixture's scripted board (see R1: board.scriptedState=true). Named stand-in: the board app, never counted clean.

notes: Fleet order ops (all on /run/fleet/control.sock, peer uid 1000): order-create -> order_claim (selftest lead) -> preflight_raise -> preflight-close -> task_decompose -> task_claim (selftest builder) -> evidence_post -> task_submit_built -> check-start -> verdict (selftest checker) -> lesson_propose (bank the task) -> report_file
